summary: Alpha brush pack split out of MPI-375 so an asset-sourcing problem cannot stall the MPI-424 umbrella. Blocked on MPI-375 (owns the shared dab helper).

UNBLOCKED, maturity blocked -> planned. MPI-375 shipped the helper this card parameterises: brushDab.js exports stampDab(ctx,x,y,r,op,fillStyle) and strokeDabs(from,to,r,stamp), already called by BOTH brushes, so a preset added inside stampDab reaches the mask and paint destinations at once. Spacing is DAB_SPACING in the same file.

Filed under the MPI-440 canvas-family umbrella #2 (mask and paint parity). Order, standing constraints and the shared alpha-vs-luminance decision are in tasks/MPI-440/brief.md - read it before starting this card.

Picked up out of MPI-440 order at the users request - 439 and 445 are being closed by a peer agent in another session, so the umbrella last member goes now. Plan: parameterise stampDab only, ten preset PARAMETER SETS in brushDab.js, picker on the shared MpiMaskStrip so mask and paint get it in one edit.

BUILT, maturity validating. 438/438 node tests (8 new in tests/brush-presets.test.cjs), eslint 0 errors on all seven touched files, plus a real-Chromium pixel probe. The probe EARNED ITS KEEP: a soft RED dab read [250,0,0,101] to [167,0,0,67] to [77,0,0,33] - Chromium interpolates canvas gradient stops NON-premultiplied, so the CSS keyword transparent (rgba 0,0,0,0) drags a soft rim through BLACK and every soft paint stroke would have carried a dark halo, silently. Fixed by fading to the colour own zero-alpha form; re-measured flat. Also proven live: two independent stampDab calls are byte-identical over a full buffer (the mask manual/subtract mirror), scattered ink stays inside dabExtent (55.15 of 65.32), and aspect+angle give a real rotated ellipse (88x54 measured, 87x52 predicted). Outstanding: the users in-app pass.
